commands.speaker: sister_aveline
commands.text: This side for waiting. That side for anyone walking through.

commands.speaker: mirel_quill
commands.text: The original goes here. New notes go on the clean board.

commands.speaker: dr_carrier
commands.text: Why not write the clearer answer on the slip?

commands.speaker: mirel_quill
commands.text: Because we have not earned a clearer answer yet.
Aveline shifts the lamp. The blurred line remains blurred, but can be seen without leaning into the passage.

commands.speaker: sister_aveline
commands.text: At least nobody has to read in the dark while we ask.
